test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 20 Jun 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘ABROAD’ is written as ‘SCBFCQ’ and 'ACCEPT' is written as 'DDBVRG'. How will ‘ACTION’ be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

**‘ABROAD’ is written as ‘SCBFCQ’,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e4185c793d7f20ddc5806001035b2ad240cf0541d15dd67bd1a1b1b5f11f9d1.png] 

**'ACCEPT' is written as 'DDBVRG',**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c588fff118d85074f48751344bc6ebc15d20f4c489816761549d244899765b40.png] 

Similarly, 

**'ACTION' can be coded as,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e9757ec5a184badf9ece483b360048a76bc192859bafdb75cdcaaed62db2ccf.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****UDBPQK"**.
